manifesto: The media archive is not a news compilation — it is an external audit of the case. Every publication here represents an independent documentation of facts confirming that the contradictions in the Lagovsky case have been recognized by the professional journalism community.

items.title: Extradition story enters its final public phase
items.summary: The article documents the transfer of the case to the Serbian Minister of Justice and shows that the extradition risk has become the subject of international attention.
items.focus: The publication establishes the case's status as 'a subject of international observation.' The defense's arguments have been heard at the European level.

items.title: Defense and prosecution documents become part of a media dispute
items.summary: The report focuses on how the Serbian court is examining the evidence and why some documents ended up in the public discussion.
items.focus: The material exposes the investigation's 'blind spot' — the ignoring of arbitration rulings. Proof that the defense documents exist physically.

items.title: Case mechanics: direct speech and expert analysis
items.summary: Analysis of legal contradictions. How a commercial dispute was 'repackaged' into a criminal charge.
items.focus: A layer of deconstruction: direct quotes from case materials and verifiable facts versus value judgments.

press_call.title: For the Press
press_call.text: The entire body of evidence — including originals of arbitration rulings, interrogation transcripts, and expert conclusions — is open and fully accessible on our website. Journalists may use these materials without restrictions.
